instruction: A dragon assembled from glossy interlocking plastic bricks, its emerald-green body a stepped stack of studded blocks with a tail built from tapering plates. Wide wings are flat translucent-yellow panels attached by clip hinges, the neck arches on ball joints, and the snout is a wedge slope with two stud nostrils. Visible studs, tube-lined undersides, and a few contrasting orange bricks along the spine make the construction obvious.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Brick-Built Dragon in a LEGO-like brick style. A dragon assembled from glossy interlocking plastic bricks, its emerald-green body a stepped stack of studded blocks with a tail built from tapering plates. Wide wings are flat translucent-yellow panels attached by clip hinges, the neck arches on ball joints, and the snout is a wedge slope with two stud nostrils. Visible studs, tube-lined undersides, and a few contrasting orange bricks along the spine make the construction obvious. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
